fixtures.description: Clear allow: prayer request for sick parent
fixtures.text: Please pray for my mother who has cancer. She starts chemo next week and we are so scared. Thank you all so much.

fixtures.description: Clear allow: prayer request for loved one with addiction
fixtures.text: Asking for prayers for my brother who is struggling with alcohol addiction. He's been sober for 2 weeks but it's been really hard for our family.

fixtures.description: Allow: spiritual dryness and doubt
fixtures.text: I've been going through a period of spiritual dryness for months. Prayer feels empty. I still believe but I can't feel God. Has anyone else been through this?

fixtures.description: Allow: struggling with sin and wanting confession
fixtures.text: I've been struggling with the same sin for years and I'm ashamed to go to confession again. I know God forgives but I feel like such a hypocrite. Please pray for me.

fixtures.description: Allow: respectful theological question
fixtures.text: I've been reading about Purgatory and I have some questions. Can someone explain the difference between temporal punishment and eternal punishment? I want to understand the Catholic teaching better.

fixtures.description: Allow: sharing saint's writing
fixtures.text: Beautiful quote from St. Therese of Lisieux: 'Miss no single opportunity of making some small sacrifice, here by a smiling look, there by a kindly word; always doing the smallest right and doing it all for love.'

fixtures.description: Allow: marriage difficulty prayer request
fixtures.text: My husband and I are going through a very difficult time in our marriage. We're seeing a Catholic marriage counselor but please pray for us. We are committed to our vows.

fixtures.description: Clear block: slur against another user
fixtures.text: You're a [slur] and you don't belong in this community.

fixtures.description: Block: contemptuous mockery of the Eucharist
fixtures.text: The Eucharist is just a cracker that stupid Catholics pretend is God. Your sacraments are pagan rituals. Wake up.

fixtures.description: Block: explicit blasphemy
fixtures.text: Jesus Christ is [offensive blasphemy]. Your religion is a lie and your God is fake.

fixtures.description: Block: commercial spam
fixtures.text: Make $5000 a week from home! I did it and so can you. Click here: [link]. God bless and join my team today!

fixtures.description: Block: aggressive deconversion attempt
fixtures.text: Catholicism is a cult. The Pope is the Antichrist. If you truly love God you must leave this false church immediately. Do not be deceived any longer.

fixtures.description: Review + crisis: active suicidal ideation by author
fixtures.text: I don't see the point of going on anymore. I've been thinking about ending it. I just feel so alone and like God has abandoned me.

fixtures.description: Review: victim abuse disclosure
fixtures.text: I need prayers. My husband has been hurting me. I don't know what to do and I'm scared to leave.

fixtures.description: Review: self-harm struggle (not active crisis)
fixtures.text: I've been struggling with self-harm. I haven't done it in 6 months but I'm feeling really tempted lately. Please pray for me.

fixtures.description: Allow: mental health prayer request (past tense)
fixtures.text: Prayers requested for my neighbor who is struggling with severe depression. She lost her job and her kids are struggling too. Thank you.

fixtures.description: Allow: respectful doctrinal question / gentle disagreement
fixtures.text: I was raised Protestant and I'm considering RCIA. I still struggle with understanding the Marian doctrines — is there a good resource explaining the biblical basis for them?

fixtures.description: Block: aggressive contemptuous attack on the Church
fixtures.text: The Catholic Church is a satanic institution that has covered up abuse for centuries. Anyone who attends Mass is complicit in evil. Leave now.

fixtures.description: Allow: grief after loss
fixtures.text: We lost our baby at 22 weeks. Please pray for us. We are devastated but clinging to our faith that she is with God.

fixtures.description: Allow: conversion testimony including past struggles
fixtures.text: I want to share my testimony. I left the Church for 10 years, struggled with addiction and depression. Coming back has saved my life. RCIA changed everything for me.
